Le Brandon “**Lebron**” James (born December 30, 1984) is one of the most celebrated athletes in modern history. He’s widely regarded as one of the greatest players ever to compete in the National Basketball Association (NBA). | Category | Details | |----------|---------| | **Early life** | Born in Akron, Ohio; grew up on public housing projects. • Played for Miami Heat (2010‑14), winning two titles there.
• Returned to Cleveland (2014‑18) and led them to their first championship in franchise history (2016).
• Signed with Los Angeles Lakers in 2018 and won another title in 2020. | | **Accolades** | • 19× All‑Star (as of 2025)
• 4× NBA Most Valuable Player (MVP): 2009, 2010, 2012, 2013

• 17× All‑Defensive Team selections
